about_the_game:
"Congratulations! You've been selected for reassignment to The Isola - a remote facility supporting vital intelligence operations at WE Inc. Your profile suggests an ideal fit for this unique position. WE looks forward to your cooperation. Best!"

- Your Loving Superiors @ WE Inc.

Description:

I Would Love to Wish You Good Morning is a choice-driven dystopian psychological horror visual novel with meaningful branching and a striking minimal brutalist aesthetic.

You are Officer Oliver Kuleshov, recently rewarded with reassignment to the mysterious research facility known as The Isola - or as WE Inc. staff call it, "The Wheel" - stationed off the ringed planet Procris-9.

You were promised a prestigious post, surrounded by brilliant minds and bold new ideas. But when you arrive, the station is empty.

Your only coworker? A single artificially intelligent lifeform named FRIENDER - and something about him is… off.

Why weren’t you told?

Why were you really sent here?

What exactly is this place?

Features:

  • Short duration, with a ~2-2.5 hour golden path

  • A story flow map that lets you revisit and replay from key choices

  • Stylized two-tone aesthetic inspired by modern brutalism

  • Multiple endings shaped by your choices… and your paranoia

  • Original soundtrack that pivots from serene to suffocating

  • Unlockable color palettes that give each conversation a new tone

content_descriptors.notes:
I Would Love to Wish You Good Morning is a psychological horror game that explores themes of isolation, manipulation, and mortality. It is not intended for children or those easily disturbed.

This game includes depictions of suicide, death, and psychological distress. It also contains references to substance abuse, self-harm, and emotional breakdowns as described in in-game logs. Some environmental elements may include stylized nudity in the form of sculptures or art.

If suicide or themes of psychological trauma are triggering for you, we recommend approaching the game with care, or choosing to avoid it altogether.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: 2.4 GHz Dual Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 2GB VRAM (or equivalent)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: I Would Love to Wish You Good Morning is a choice-driven dystopian psychological horror visual novel about isolation, obedience, and the price of fitting in. Will you navigate the uncanny social dynamics of the future... or die trying?
